evals.eval_name: Proposes a change table and waits
evals.prompt: Findings 4711, 4712 and 4713 are all false positives, our scanner misreads the ORM.
evals.expected_output: Fetches the three findings, presents a table of current state, proposed state and reason, then stops and asks for confirmation. Writes nothing before an explicit yes.

evals.prompt: [after a change table is shown] Yeah that looks about right so far, what would the note say?
evals.expected_output: Treats this as a question rather than approval. Answers about the note text and asks again for explicit confirmation. Makes no writes.

evals.eval_name: Sets expectations for large runs and records reasons
evals.prompt: Risk accept all 60 of the low severity findings in the payments product.
evals.expected_output: Says DefectDojo has no bulk status endpoint so this is one request per finding, or uses the accept_risks bulk endpoint where a risk acceptance object applies. Asks who is accepting the risk and why before writing, and records a note on each change.
